skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts and trends of environmental technology.
Understand the processes and implementation of pollution prevention technologies.
Understand the concepts of clean technology and sustainable production.
Understand the processes and technologies for waste management and recycling.
Understand the techniques and methods for controlling air pollution.
Understand the processes and technologies for water treatment and wastewater management.
Understand the processes and technologies for solid waste treatment and hazardous waste management.
Understand the criteria and methods for evaluating environmental technologies.
Develop the ability to propose and evaluate environmental technologies in practical applications.
Develop the ability to work independently and in groups, engage in self-study, research, write reports, and present professionally.
